constraints.name: outbox_payload_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text THEN NOT jsonb_path_exists(payload, 'strict $.keyvalue()?(!(@."key" like_regex "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$") || !(@."value".type() == "string" && @."value" like_regex "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$" || @."value".type() == "array" && !(exists (@."value"[*]?(!(@.type() == "string" && @ like_regex "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))))))'::jsonpath)
    ELSE false
END)
